objective: Make seconds-long generic neuronal simulation practically fast before stage3; same equations and external error criteria, no anatomical dispatch

alternatives.A: Compiled C++ callbacks and per-operation CUDA graphs; dynamic device parameter block. Remove Python callback hot path, redundant derivatives and duplicate finite checks. Same integrator and diagonal preconditioner as repaired reference.
alternatives.B: Generated block preconditioning with separate setup/apply; graph dependencies, not anatomical labels; hold native callback change out when comparing.
alternatives.C: Declared global linear/nonlinear IMEX split when stiffness decomposition is justified; differs from failed local diagonal exponential.

performance_targets.primary: one simulated second within60 wall seconds on a measured large supported load
performance_targets.sustained: at least10 continuous simulated seconds in bounded minutes, with long-horizon error checks; preserve explicit baseline where it wins
performance_targets.promotion: material >=2x speedup vs same-equation repaired parent at matched precision; no claim for whole biological brain from a synthetic load

preimplementation.observed_limitation: 61502 Python callbacks and38223 coupled evaluations in previous large precise solve; many evaluate unused derivatives, preparatory work repeated by preconditioner
preimplementation.new_operation: device parameter block contains current x/v/destination pointers and time/gamma; copy into same stream before graph, inspect aggregate finite flag before callback returns
preimplementation.legal_information: model equations, live state, Jacobian products, constant sparse mass and immutable parameters; no target trajectories used by solver
preimplementation.closest_prior: SUNDIALS matrix-free ARKStep and CUDA stream capture/runtime code generation; engineering reuse, no novelty claim
preimplementation.falsifier: alternate pointer addresses and reuse addresses with changed values; invalid then valid calls must neither hide errors nor reuse stale flags; trajectories meet existing criteria

scope: Two v2 defects fixed in common control before timing; sources/results preserved. Author-exposed development, no stage3 admission.
